create.name: Jamie Wozny
create.bio:
Jamie Wozny is a Los Angeles meditation guide, Reiki master and intuitive coach who describes herself as a seer and priestess. She came to this work after a long stretch of burnout and feeling cut off from herself, and her teaching grew out of what helped her find her way back: self-acceptance, listening to the body and emotions, and a felt relationship with the divine. Her themes are self-love, feminine power, firm boundaries, abundance and living from one's own truth rather than from people-pleasing.

She works with private clients by video, leads a weekly online circle and regular live talks on Insight Timer, and has made a large library of guided meditations, prayers and audio courses, many of them on that app. Her paid courses include programmes on following inspiration and on speaking one's truth, as well as on-demand Reiki levels one and two and a certification in animal communication, a strand of her work she also shares on a separate channel. She speaks for companies and groups, in person around Los Angeles or online, and has written a book on awakening the heart, a collection of poems and a self-discovery journal.

books.title: Set Free Your Longing Heart: A Journey of Awakening to Your Radiant Light, Authentic Truth & Full Magnificence
books.author: Jamie Wozny
books.description: Her book on turning back towards intuition and the heart's real wishes in a culture that prizes logic. It encourages readers to find a steady sense of love and worth inside themselves.

books.title: Becoming The Lioness: A Self Discovery Journal to Activate Your Power
books.author: Jamie Wozny
books.description: A guided journal with eight prompts on personal power, each followed by open pages for writing or drawing. It is meant to be worked through at the reader's own pace.

courses.title: Abundance Codes | Following Your Inspiration
courses.description: An eight-week recorded course on letting inspiration and joy guide choices about money, work and purpose. It uses meditations and energy practices to move from a sense of lack towards ease.

courses.title: Live Your Bold Truth In 6 Lessons
courses.description: Six recorded lessons with guided practices on trusting inner truth, dropping patterns that hold back abundance and building a life that fits one's purpose.

courses.title: Reiki 1 & 2 On-Demand Certification
courses.description: Recorded Reiki training in two levels: the first gives the attunement and self-practice, the second teaches sending Reiki at a distance. Each level can be bought alone or both as a bundle.
courses.price: Reiki 1: $195 USD; Reiki 2: $295 USD; bundle $450 USD

courses.title: Animal Communication Certification
courses.description: An on-demand course in intuitive communication with animals, taught on the view that anyone can learn to sense what their animals are expressing.

courses.title: The Sanctuary Circle
courses.description: A weekly 45-minute group on Zoom every Tuesday afternoon, Pacific time, mixing meditation, movement, expression and intuitive energy work. Participants choose what to pay within a set range.
